correctness.rationale: The affine area identity is direct. The local parameterization is bijective and has Jacobian t²|log(ta)|; its fixed compact chart and integrable logarithmic majorant give L1 density convergence by dominated convergence. Six corner charts contribute 3t²log(1/t), matching the exact published scalar normalization, so outside chart mass vanishes. L1 normalization establishes joint total variation. The finite checker corroborates but does not prove this.

value.rationale: The conditional degeneracy geometry of the exact classic one-point-per-side triangle model is a natural missing structural observable. Unlike known scalar CDF/moments, it classifies six corners, determines all relative multiplicative approach scales and a correlated Dirichlet area budget, and provides a rare-event importance-sampling coordinate chart. Neither a routine scalar derivative nor a relabeling of existing geometry.
